name: alnadl-hospitality-os
description: ALNADL Hospitality OS — QR ordering and hospitality operations platform

comments.runtime: The server had zero runtime dependencies until QR entry required a real encoder. qrcode@1.5.3 is pinned exactly (no caret) because a QR code is the product's entry point: a silent minor-version change in the encoder is not something we want arriving without a scan test. It is the only runtime dependency; everything else remains node:http, node:sqlite and node:crypto.
comments.playwright: Required ONLY by tests/engage-security.js (real-DOM XSS verification) and scripts/build-docs-pdf.js (PDF rendering). It is optional because the other 31 test suites run without it: when absent, engage-security skips with an explicit SKIPPED line rather than failing, so a fresh extraction with no install still produces a meaningful suite result. Install it to run the full suite including browser verification: `npm install && npx playwright install chromium`.
comments.why-no-lockfile: There is no package-lock.json because dependencies is empty and playwright is optional. Adding a lockfile would imply a reproducible dependency graph the server does not have and does not need.
comments.qrcode: Server-side only. Generating in the browser would mean shipping the library to the client, which the no-CDN rule forbids; generating server-side means one code path serves display, download and print alike. Chosen over smaller zero-dependency alternatives because those return a module matrix only, which would put the SVG/PNG rendering back in our hands -- the exact thing a library is supposed to avoid owning.
